messages.en: There are so many patients at this clinic. I still haven't seen the doctor.
It's okay, just wait a bit longer. I'm already at the shop next door.
Mom left a note on the fridge. Read it before you go out, okay?
I've read it. Mom wants us to close all the windows, right?
Mom left you a message: don't forget to lock the door later.
I've read the message. I'll lock it later, don't worry.

senses.en_definition: A machine, apparatus or piece of equipment.
A mechanism or component, such as a rope or chain, that transmits motion to drive machinery.

messages.en: Mom, my plane's landed. I'll get my bags first, then text you when I'm outside.
Okay, I'll wait at the pickup area. No rush, I've only just got here.
